notes: Scared Stiff auxiliary lamp probe. Boot from an empty NVRAM with four balls in the trough (public 32-35), press service Escape once to leave the fresh-NVRAM FACTORY SETTINGS RESTORED / BOOKKEEPING TOTALS CLEARED loop, observe attract mode for 120 s, close the coin door, insert two coins and press Start, then roll each skull lane (public 71-73) twice. Midway's 1996 development notes say the prototype lit a pair of skull eyes when a skull lane was rolled, so the run records whether the driver-declared auxiliary lamp addresses 91-98 and 101-108 and their shift-register drive lines 37/38 (mirrors 41/42) change. Run it unchanged on the production and prototype drivers and compare. A transition proves only that the ROM wrote the address; silence on one driver proves nothing about the physical machine on its own.
